category_name: Localized lighting, depth and bleak atmosphere without hiding geometry

strengths.finding: The worker arch has a readable cool key zone, grounded floor shadows and a darker terminal gate and ceiling. Forward and reverse geometry remain clear.
Warm localized hatch and office light makes task props readable, while darker apron and underdesk values preserve working-zone depth.
Cargo curtain/rollers respond visibly to their strip; trolley cloth is sculpted by a separate warm pool with rail/wheel contact shadows.
The room has readable practical falloff, darker secondary structure and separated pools. Bleak institutional restraint is sustained without dominant flat even exposure or excessive emissive glow.

deductions.finding: Dark vertical conduits and mounts compress against the black backing; the neutral render separates their routing and construction distinctly. Main boxes and upper pipe bends remain readable.
deductions.recommendation: Introduce restrained local reflected or edge light on the dark conduit runs while retaining the dim service-wall hierarchy.

deductions.finding: Lower conveyor supports and portions of the front/side frame merge in near-black values. Neutral reveals more construction. The curtain, crate, rollers and primary silhouette remain readable.
deductions.recommendation: Separate adjacent dark frame/rail planes with a small amount of controlled fill rather than raising whole-room exposure.

deductions.finding: Cabinet outer surrounds, the small office wall cabinet and far trolley support retain limited tonal separation. The readable doors and main supported forms prevent this from becoming a geometry-hiding veto.
deductions.recommendation: Preserve low secondary values while adding just enough local plane separation to retain support and reveal detail.

conclusion: Category 5 earns 96/100 and passes the strict >93 and zero-critical category gates. It does not earn 99: localized shadow compression still suppresses specific construction details. This review does not certify overall acceptance, native technical checks, regression stability or runtime lighting.
